notes: Race labels are manually registered in data/entered/races.json.
Training features for each race use only runs before the race start and exclude the race activity itself.

Each race time is normalized to neutral conditions (flat road, ~10 C) before the fit using course profile, temperature and surface; predictions are neutral and the goal race is re-adjusted to its own conditions.
Temperature comes from a per-race override when present, otherwise Montreal monthly climatology, since Strava activities here carry no temperature.
series spans every prediction distance daily from the first run through race day; days after the last run hold current fitness flat (maintenance projection).
